CustomField.description: [Formula] This field looks at Dual_Plan__c or Dual Program__c to determine if it's checked or not. If either Dual Program or Dual Plan have data in them, this will be checked as TRUE.
CustomField.formula: AND( IF(NOT ISBLANK(Dual_Plan__c), TRUE, IF(NOT ISBLANK(Dual_Program__c), TRUE, FALSE)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will be checked if Dual Program or Dual Plan are populated. If both are blank, it will be unchecked.
CustomField.label: Joint Program
